data.name: Satyaranjan
data.gender_notes: Satyaranjan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is filled with Truth and Honesty. The name Satyaranjan carries the meaning “Truthful, Honest” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Satyaranjan usually hope their child will grow to embody truthful, honest and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents a deep connection to the truth and a commitment to living an honest life
data.etymology: Satyaranjan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Truthful, Honest.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Satyaranjan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Satyaranjan" holds deep cultural significance in Hinduism, as it emphasizes the importance of truth and honesty in one's actions and moral character. In Indian society, the name is often used to instill these virtues in children and is revered as a reminder of the ethical conduct expected of individuals within the community.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Satyaranjan" also holds immense spiritual significance as it represents a person's quest for truth and the search for authenticity in life. In Hinduism, Satya (truth) is considered one of the fundamental aspects of Dharma (ethical conduct). Pursuing truth, living an honest life, and striving for authenticity in one's relationship with God and the universe are core aspects of spiritual growth for many Hindus. Overall, the name "Satyaranjan" is an embodiment of the eternal pursuit of truth and ethics, both culturally and spiritually, within the Hindu community.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Satyaranjan: Truth-Bringer. embodiment of truth and righteousness in action. A beacon of honesty and integrity.
